lines: Welcome to the Wayfarer Guild, Avelorn chapter. The Sundering left machines running wild out there; we survey, we clear, we report.
Start in Dawnmeadow through the East Gate. Come back when the Mosskin herds are thinner.
Rations, tonics, feathers, all fresh. Prices are Guild-fixed, so don't haggle.
Sell me your field materials, one by one or the whole bag at once.
Sit down, let me look at you. There, good as new.
The tonics I can't give you away, but the Merchant sells them.
The transit lattice runs to the camp of every field. A little coin keeps the crystals charged.
The further the field, the more it costs.
Bring me materials and I'll make you something that keeps you alive.
Copper gears? Craglets swallow them. Don't ask me why.
East Gate. Dawnmeadow lies beyond, and past it every field in turn, each ten levels harder.
If you see three dozen of anything chasing you, run for a camp.
The North Gate is closed: the road north runs through the fields now.
Take the East Gate, or the transit by the square.
Going up? The lift reaches Avelorn or the orchard.
Mind your head on the roots.
Dawnmeadow runs from Lv 1 by this camp to Lv 10 in the east.
Mosskin Meadow (Lv 1-1): Mosskin. Sporeling Hollow (Lv 2-3): Sporeling, Ambermite. Glider Rise (Lv 3-5): Lunari, Craglet. Bramble Mill (Lv 8-9): Thornback, Dustwing.
Sit a while. Nothing follows you into the camp.
Drag them as far as you like, but come back breathing.
Back to Avelorn whenever you want it. The ride is on the Guild.
East is Moonbrook Vale, Lv 11 and up.
I can send you back to Avelorn.
Moonbrook Vale runs from Lv 11 by this camp to Lv 20 in the east.
Brookbed (Lv 12-12): Brookfin. Reed Marsh (Lv 14-16): Reedstalker, Graftling. Rotting Rows (Lv 17-18): Rotroot, Mossback Newt. Sap Groves (Lv 20-20): Sapdrone.
Sit a while. Nothing follows you into the camp.
Drag them as far as you like, but come back breathing.

East is Graftwood Wilds, Lv 21 and up.
I can send you back to Avelorn.
Rations and tonics, marked up for the long road.
Bring me sap and scales; the alchemists pay well for anything green.
Field drops make better supplies than the merchant's, if you bring enough of them.
Newt slick for vital tonic, moth scale for focus. Graftling twigs make decent bread ovens, too.
Root lift's working. Avelorn, or back up to Elderroot Expanse?
Don't touch the sap lines; they bite.
Graftwood Wilds runs from Lv 21 by this camp to Lv 30 in the east.

I can send you back to Avelorn.
Water's dear out in the Wastes, and everything else costs too.
Rations and tonics at Guild prices. Sell me your glass; the observatory buys it all.
Sand and glass make good supplies if you know what to do with them.
Jackal pelts render down for vital tonic. Scarab glass makes a decent focus draught.
The lift runs to Avelorn or back up to Pearl Coast.
Don't look straight into the mirrors.
Saffron Wastes runs from Lv 41 by this camp to Lv 50 in the east.

East is Pearl Coast, Lv 51 and up.
I can send you back to Avelorn.
Rations, tonics, the same Guild prices as everywhere, plus the cost of shipping them.
Bring me what the reef gives you. Inland buyers pay well for anything from the sea.
Kelp, hopper tendon, medusa jelly: all useful, once you know how to boil it.
I make rations and tonics from what you bring. Cheaper than the merchant, if you do the gathering.
Pearl Coast runs from Lv 51 by this camp to Lv 60 in the east.

I can send you back to Avelorn.
Rations and tonics, Guild prices plus the cost of hauling them up the mountain.
Anything crystal sells well here. The labs buy everything.
Hare haunch, mite gel, wisp dust. The mountain feeds you if you know what to boil.
I'll make rations and tonics from your materials, cheaper than the merchant.
Going up? Back to Cinder Expanse or all the way to Avelorn.
The vault is past the index gallery. The lancers there shoot far.
Frostfire Divide runs from Lv 61 by this camp to Lv 70 in the east.

I can send you back to Avelorn.
Rations and tonics, hauled a long way. Heat spoils everything, so I charge what it costs to keep them cool.
Bring me Emberfall scrap; the foundries buy all I can ship.
Slag glands, vent bladders, cheap ash meat: I can turn your surplus into tonics for less than the shop asks.
Don't sell me Living Embers. Keep them. You'll know why soon enough.
Cinder Expanse runs from Lv 71 by this camp to Lv 80 in the east.

Rations and tonics, brought in on the transit. Nothing grows past the Rift any more, so nothing's cheap.
Bring me lattice scrap. The scholars pay in coin they don't need.
Blooms, wisp cores, lurk bristles: I make tonics from what the city leaves us.
Lattice Nodes are the real treasure. Hold on to them.
Back up? Avelorn or the Gate.
Don't look at the lattice too long. It looks back.
Veil Rift runs from Lv 81 by this camp to Lv 90 in the east.
